svg.title: Cell finalization and saved cell records
svg.desc: Three planned padded tiles and two overlapping candidate cells retain the same coordinates in every enlarged view. All intersecting footprints must succeed, including an empty tile. Memory-first retention can write evicted candidates once to temporary storage. Native InstanSeg reconciles the complete group in original order. The finalized cell and nucleus remain paired through shape measurement, stable identity, Parquet writing, spatial sorting and reopening. Geometry and row labels are schematic.
svg.text: A + B overlap with positive area
